Photo location guide

Photo Location Guides for iPhone and Mac

Start with the problem you can see. Check your photos, choose a manual or batch method, then verify the saved locations.

Updated November 4, 2026

Choose the problem you want to solve

Add Location to Camera Photos in Apple Photos

Add a known place in Apple Photos, copy a location on Mac, or match a trip using iPhone photos. Check camera times before saving.

Add Location to Photos on Mac: Manual and Batch

Use the Photos Info window, find photos not tagged with GPS in a Smart Album, and review batch suggestions with LensPin for Mac.

Geotag Photos with GPX on Mac: Match and Check

Use a timed GPX track to locate camera photos on Mac. Check track coverage, time zones, camera clock offsets and saved results.

Camera Photos Have No Location? Check and Fix GPS

Check missing GPS in Sony, Fujifilm, Canon, DJI Osmo and Ricoh photos, then add known places or match location evidence afterwards.

Camera Photos Not on the Apple Photos Map? Fix It

Find out whether GPS is missing, a location is wrong, or you are viewing another copy. Check camera photos and fix their library locations.
